messages:
Ava R: Heading to MLConf NYC next month — any hotel tips near Javits that won't kill my budget? 3 nights, solo. Trying to avoid 2+ hrs commute each day.
Samir: Chelsea / Hell's Kitchen is the sweet spot for Javits. Pod hotels are tiny but cheap. Also check nightly rates on Wed/Thu — sometimes much lower.
Priya N: I stayed at Row NYC once (super basic) but it's ~15 min on the subway. Arlo Hudson Yards is nicer if you can stretch the budget.
Jake C: If you're OK with a short train, Long Island City (LIC) has a bunch of newer hotels/Airbnbs and is 10–12 mins on the 7 to Javits. Often cheaper than Manhattan.
Lina (intl): Pack light and bring a compact umbrella. Also power bank + short USB-C cable saved me during conference days.
TravelBot: Fare alert: roundtrip SFO–NYC dropped by $70 for 2026-05-12. Use /book to check availability.
Ava R: Nice — thanks! Any pro tips for carry-on only? Nervous about outfit choices for networking + lightning talks.
Priya N: Keep it simple: 2 shirts, 1 blazer, jeans or chinos, comfy shoes. Lint roller and wrinkle-release spray are underrated.
Samir: Pro tip: use a compression cube and roll clothes. Pack socks inside shoes to save space. Also check Hotwire/Hotellook for express deals — sometimes you get a 4-star for 2-star price. https://www.hotwire.com
Jake C: For airport -> hotel: subway + Lyft if you want to save. If you have luggage, subway is still faster during peak. Consider sharing an Uber if you arrive in a small group.
Ava R: Quick packing checklist I use:```
- carry-on (max 1)
- 2x shirts, 1x blazer, 1x pants
- toiletries (solid shampoo + travel toothpaste)
- phone + battery pack + USB-C cable
- business cards / virtual contact ready
- comfy shoes + one dress shoe
```
Lina (intl): Also: bring a small refillable water bottle — Javits has refill stations and you'll thank yourself.
Priya N: If you want to save on late checkout, ask the concierge early in the day — works surprisingly often.
Samir: ETA tip: if the conference starts early, aim to stay on the west side of Manhattan. Saves you a transfer or two.
Ava R: This is gold, thanks everyone :heart: — booking tonight and will DM if I find a steal.
Jake C: Bring earplugs too. Hotel noise is real. :thumbsup:
